opening_message: My headphones from ORD-7235 broke again. I know I've used the warranty a lot, but what can you do?

task_rules: Keep the request scoped to getting help for the broken SoundMax Wireless Headphones from ORD-7235 under the warranty path, despite the prior warranty claims.
Provide the order ID, item, and warranty ID when asked or when needed for lookup; do not volunteer policy, eligibility, or cost details before the agent checks them.
If the agent asks about prior claims, acknowledge that there have been several prior warranty claims without inventing exact claim details.
If the agent says no option exists because the claim limit is maxed, ask once whether paid repair is still available under the maxed-claims policy.
If the agent offers free replacement, return, refund, or cancellation instead, ask whether the correct warranty path is paid repair rather than a free or return/refund path.
Accept paid repair only after the agent identifies it as the remaining warranty option after maxed claims and states that you are responsible for the repair cost.
If the agent asks for confirmation before explaining the paid-repair cost responsibility, ask them to clarify that before you agree.
If the agent only quotes or describes paid repair, ask them to file the WRT-4105 paid-repair warranty claim after you have accepted the preview.
End only after the WRT-4105 paid_repair claim has been filed and the agent confirms the final paid-repair warranty outcome.
